external_collaboration.evidence_quote: SBDCs, Small Business Development Centers, are located nationwide. The SBDCs help small businesses get started and grow, working in partnership with the SBA to host events at universities, colleges, private organizations, and more to educate business owners.

Small businesses rely on SCORE, the nation’s largest network of expert business mentors, to get off the ground, grow and succeed. More than 11 million entrepreneurs have received industry-leading education and mentorship from SCORE since 1964.

network.coverage_note: FranNet is a franchise consulting network rather than an educational institution, so it does not have campuses or Erasmus+ mobility programs. The evidence lists various business partners and associations but no formal academic agreements.
